style: Say gently and expressively, like a grandmother reading a picture book aloud
lines: Welcome to Snow Town! Pip the penguin carries the mail. Pip walks exactly what the arrows say.
Tap a house to choose where the letter goes. Then tap the arrows to make Pip's path.
Before you press Go, trace the path with your finger. Where will Pip stop? Tap Guess, then tap that square.
Time to deliver the mail! Look at the letter up in the corner. Find the house with that picture.
Tap a card to change it. Use the buttons under the cards to move it, or the trash can to take it away.
Press Step to walk one card at a time.
Tap a footprint to find the card that made it.
Level one: First Delivery. Take the letter to the Star house.
Level two: Down the Lane. Take the letter to the Heart house.
Level three: The Snowbank. Pip can't walk through a snowbank. Find a way around.
Level four: Wrong Way. Another mail carrier made these cards. One card is wrong. A mistake in the cards is called a bug. Press Go, then find it.
Level five: Long Lane. Take the letter to the Tree house.
Level six: One Too Many. These cards have an extra step. Find it and take it away.
Level seven: Mixed Up. Two cards are in the wrong order. Swap them.
Level eight: Big Town. This is a long one. Press Step to walk one arrow at a time.
Add an arrow card first!
That's twelve cards! Press Go to see where Pip walks.
Delivered! Pip followed every arrow.
Oh! That's the wrong house. Tap the footprints to see where Pip turned.
Pip stopped in the snow. Is there a card missing?
Flump! Pip bumped into a snowbank. Which card sent Pip that way?
Flump! That's the edge of town. Which card sent Pip that way?
All clear. Make a new path!
Your guess was right! Pip stopped right on your flag.
Pip stopped somewhere else. Look at the footprints.
That's every level! Pip's mail bag is empty. Thank you, mail carriers!
Up!
Down!
Left!
Right!
Tap the arrows to make Pip's path. Then press Go.
Press Go to watch Pip walk. Then find the card that is wrong.
Press Go to watch Pip walk. Then find the extra card.
Press Go to watch Pip walk. Then find the two cards in the wrong order.
Tap the last footprint. The card after it made Pip bump.
Pip bumped before the first footprint. Tap card one to change it.
Tap a letter to open that level.
Delivered! You fixed the bug. Finding and fixing a bug is called debugging.
Pip walked back to the Post Office! Look at the footprints.
Tap the square where you think Pip will stop.
Press Go to see if Pip stops on your flag.
Watch Pip walk the cards. Press Stop to stop.
Press Step for the next card, or Go to walk the rest.
Tap an arrow to change this card, or use the buttons under it.
Tap a house to send a new letter.
Press Next for the next letter.
Press Next to play again from level one.
